items.text: Markets: Wall Street's Thanksgiving Eve plate is all bitter vegetables. Before the bell, Nasdaq-100 futures are down about 3%, S&P 500 futures down 2%, and Dow futures down 1.3% on hot inflation, new tariffs, and Nvidia sliding again. Closed Thursday, half-day Friday.
Markets: Bitcoin slips back under $59K. Down about 24% in November, on pace for its worst month since June 2022 and an eighth straight losing week. Diamond hands getting tested fr.
Leveling Up: The economy. Q3 GDP got revised up to 4.3% growth from 3.4%. Inflation leveled up too: October PCE hit 3.8%, and traders now see a December rate hike as basically locked in.

What's New: Tariffs went from rumor to official. The administration proposed new tariffs on 14 trading partners, including an extra 20% on China stacked on top of the 25% from 2018. Earliest start: January.

Happening Now: The Army is detonating the nation's entire stockpile of lead azide, about 5 tons, in Middletown, Iowa this morning. First time since 1977. People up to 20 miles out are told to stay inside with the windows shut.

Took a Hit: Monday, Mike McCarthy said "Aaron Rodgers is our quarterback." Tuesday night, the Steelers benched him. Mason Rudolph starts Friday vs. the Broncos, and Rodgers may have played his last snap.

Still Broken: FinCEN is dealing with a hack, and Treasury's CIO, whose department handles its cybersecurity, was pushing after-midnight updates to his AI-coded Civilization clone. Good news: the Aztecs got their own music.
What's New: Jensen Huang's first all-hands back at Nvidia: "I hurt all of you," he's in therapy, and the hardest meeting of his life was with his wife. Senate Banking hearing is next week.
Took a Hit: Every GTA 6 ad says "Plays Best on PS5." Digital Foundry says the base PS5 drops frames way more often than Xbox Series X. Only the PS5 Pro keeps the slogan honest.

Took a Hit: Your wallet, if you still want a Cybertruck. The Cyberbeast is up another $5,000 to $114,990, it's the only trim you can order, and leases are gone. Same price as early 2026, minus all the perks.
Still Broken: The 100th Macy's parade vs. the wind. NYC is forecast for 30-45 mph gusts during the parade, and balloons get grounded above 34. Final call comes Thursday morning.

Leveling Up: Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping, fresh off a $120M opening, is projected to eat $80-90M over the Thanksgiving five-day. Focker In-Law and Disney's $200M+ Hexed are fighting for seconds.
Fixed: Gas keeps dropping before the road trip. AAA's national average is $3.59, down from $3.72 a week ago. Still a hair above the priciest Thanksgiving on record ($3.58 in 2022).
